skill.summary: 系统九要素 — 将任意对象视作系统来解构的九维度框架。 当用户需要：把某事物当系统拆解、研究一个系统的内部机理、系统性解构一个问题、设计一个系统、写深度分析报告时激活。 激活词：九要素、系统拆解、像系统一样分析、把它拆解成系统、把X当作系统

latestVersion.changelog:
system-nine-elements 1.0.0

- Initial release with a comprehensive nine-dimensional framework for analyzing any object as a system.
- Includes clear definitions, core questions, and checklists for each of the nine elements.
- Provides a structured analysis process and unified output format to support deep system decomposition and reporting.
- Tailored activation phrases trigger system-level breakdowns.
